verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a REST API for reading and writing space content. It also offers a TypeScript SDK (npm @capacities/api), an OpenAPI 3.0 spec with an interactive try-it reference, a developer portal with SDK samples, and a guide for building custom MCP-client apps, agents or bots. So developers can build their own external integrations against documented tooling, but nothing shows an in-app plugin system that runs inside Capacities. The current Beta API is also scheduled for deprecation on September 1, 2026, in favour of the new portal. Missing for 10: an in-app plugin/extension runtime and API, plugin-specific samples or templates, a plugin distribution or install mechanism, and independent hands-on corroboration.
